intro_day.headline: Zero's Regime Marks Another Year of 'Order'
intro_day.body: Celebrations in the Upper District. Labour quotas for the powerless rise again.

social.author: nexa_daily
social.t: Another year under the new order. Top-ranked heroes receive free mansions this season.

picnic_announced.headline: Nexa Academy Plans Jungle Field Trip
picnic_announced.body: Students will wear tracking watches for safety.

boy_found_in_cave.headline: Student Found Critically Injured Near Jungle Ruins
boy_found_in_cave.body: Teachers located the boy using his tracking watch. The ruins have been sealed.

social.author: dex_steel
social.t: lol the powerless kid got lost in a cave

trial_silver.headline: Strange Movement at Academy Trial
trial_silver.body: Witnesses describe a 'silver blur'. The academy declined to comment.

social.author: zip_storm
social.t: did anyone else see Parker DODGE Bruce?? like actually??

mall_attack_stopped.headline: Teen Stops Villain at Nexa Grand Mall
mall_attack_stopped.body: Shoppers say an unranked student defeated the power-draining villain 'Hex Ripper'.

social.author: nexa_daily
social.t: Who is the unranked student who stopped Hex Ripper?

mall_attack_solaris.headline: Captain Solaris Drives Off Mall Attacker
mall_attack_solaris.body: A student was seen fighting the villain before heroes arrived.

social.author: nexa_daily
social.t: Captain Solaris saves the day again.

crews_attack_rumor.headline: Two Students Hospitalised After Street 'Accident'
crews_attack_rumor.body: Police say there are no suspects.

social.author: selene_noir
social.t: Some people should know their place.

peter_missing.headline: Academy Student Missing
peter_missing.body: Peter Parker, 16, left hospital without a trace. His mother asks anyone with information to come forward.

social.author: john_reyes
social.t: If anyone sees Peter, please message me. Please.

crews_mock_peter.headline: Pro Hero Crews Dominate the Rankings
crews_mock_peter.body: Frostfire Dominion's Bruce Kaizer is now the No. 4 hero. Asked about old classmates, he laughed: 'The powerless kid? He ran away.'

social.author: bruce_kaizer
social.t: Ten years. Some of us got stronger. Some of us ran.

competition_announced.headline: Grand Power Competition Announced
competition_announced.body: Professor Hale will host the largest competition in a decade. Registration closes in three days.

social.author: nexa_daily
social.t: Who will enter the Grand Power Competition?

grand_competition_result.headline: UNKNOWN CHALLENGER WINS GRAND COMPETITION
grand_competition_result.body: Peter Parker — once mocked as powerless — has stunned all of Nexa.

social.author: zip_storm
social.t: WHAT just happened at the challenge??

white_lantern_rumor.headline: Astronomers Detect White Light Over Distant Sector
white_lantern_rumor.body: A flare of unknown energy lit up a far star system.

daily.headline: Labour quotas for the powerless raised by 5%
daily.body: Workers protest quietly outside the Bureau.

daily.headline: Frostfire Dominion tops Academy crew rankings again
New shopping wing opens at Nexa Grand Mall
daily.body: Top-ranked heroes shop free on opening day.

Villain sighting in the Commercial District
Zero's emblem now required on all public buildings

daily.body: Paws & Wings opens a second store.
